summary.text: Kebbi was born in war: Kanta Kotal broke from Songhai in 1516 and built the fortress capital Surame. After the jihad its rulers held out at Argungu.

arms.text: Kebbi’s armies were bowmen and horsemen.
The walled fortress of Surame, later Argungu.

record.text: Kanta Kotal threw off Songhai rule.
The jihad drove Kebbi’s rulers out; they fought on from Argungu.
